runners_data.spotlight: Won over hurdles at Clonmel and fences at Gowran last month but disappointed here over fences last time so has to rebound; claims if he does.

races.paceDynamic: Maxxum, Look To The West, and Mount Frisco will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with all three natural front runners unlikely to give each other an easy lead. The pace will be genuine throughout this 2m4f chase on soft ground, stretching the field and testing stamina reserves. With three confirmed pace-setters and only two hold-up horses (Dee Capo and Along The Way), the early tempo will be demanding. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the genuine pace will string out the field and allow closers to pick up the pieces.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the three front runners go too fast early and tire
scenarios.body: The strong early pace will take its toll on Maxxum, Look To The West and Mount Frisco, allowing the two hold-up horses to come through with late runs. Dee Capo has the class advantage with an OR of 150 and should benefit most from the predicted pace collapse.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front runner survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders gets first run and maintains kick
scenarios.body: Maxxum or Look To The West could use their class edge to break clear before the closers can respond effectively. The winner would need to be the most economical of the three pace-setters to have enough left for the finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mount Frisco rebounds
scenarios.trigger: If Mount Frisco improves sharply from last disappointing effort
scenarios.body: Despite his lower rating, Mount Frisco's recent Gowran win and quick return suggest connections are confident of a bounce-back performance. His front-running style could steal a march if the other pace-setters neutralize each other.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If all three front runners tie up badly in the closing stages
scenarios.body: The demanding early pace on soft ground could see all pace-setters struggle home, leaving Along The Way to benefit despite his modest ability. This would require a complete pace meltdown but is possible given the setup.

watchPoints.text: Watch for Maxxum and Look To The West setting unsustainable fractions early as neither will want to give the other an easy lead.
Monitor Mount Frisco's jumping after his disappointing effort here last time - any early mistakes would end his chances quickly.
Check if Dee Capo travels smoothly in behind - his hold-up style needs the race to unfold as expected to be effective.
Look for Along The Way to be niggled along early to stay in touch as his modest ability could see him detached if not positioned well.
Watch the pace through the first mile - if it's not genuinely strong, the front runners' chances improve significantly.

races.paceDynamic: Made In The Woods will attempt to lead but faces no real pressure early, creating a sustainable gallop that suits patient types. The seven prominent runners (Baldur's Gate, Mount Shenshan, Is Charlie Around, My Cullen, Rusheen, Carlas Big Jim, Roc My Haarth, Snow Punt, Reve Inoui) will create traffic congestion approaching the business end, with scrimmaging likely from 3 furlongs out as they jostle for position. This leaves a clear path for the six hold-up horses (Rhythmic Tune, North Of Nashville, Long Road, The Rebel County, Without Exception, Wyoming Baby) to make their challenge in cleaner air. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the controlled pace will leave them with plenty to aim at and the prominent pack will create interference.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays controlled and the prominent pack creates traffic problems as expected
scenarios.body: The patient horses will have too much ammunition late and sweep past the struggling prominent group. Wyoming Baby, Rhythmic Tune and The Rebel County can exploit their tactical advantage with clean runs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pack Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners can organize themselves and avoid significant interference
scenarios.body: One of the well-positioned prominent horses will kick clear before the hold-up horses can respond. Is Charlie Around or Snow Punt have the class to capitalize on their forward positions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Made In The Woods Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If no horse applies serious pressure to the leader throughout
scenarios.body: The front runner will have saved enough energy to resist the late challenges, particularly on this stamina-testing trip. Made In The Woods gets a soft lead and finds extra when challenged.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses go too fast trying to catch Made In The Woods early
scenarios.body: The field will come back to the most patient finishers who were held up furthest off the pace. The Rebel County and Without Exception will benefit from an overly aggressive middle section.

watchPoints.text: Made In The Woods could get such an easy lead that he proves impossible to peg back despite moderate recent form

Wyoming Baby's tendency to fade in finish could be crucial given the stamina demands of this 2m7½f trip
Carlas Big Jim has no declared jockey which suggests stable problems and makes him a non-runner risk
Mount Shenshan wearing headgear for first time after string of poor runs could signal significant improvement expected

races.paceDynamic: Drombane will take them along from the front as the sole confirmed leader, setting a sustainable gallop over this extended trip on soft ground. With no obvious pace pressure from the field full of hold-up merchants like Kaiser De Chanay, Shine Bright, and Keep Em Quite, plus prominent runners Fabhcun and Lord Of The Locke sitting in behind, Drombane can dictate terms throughout. The lack of early pace will see the field bunch up turning for home, creating a tactical finish where positioning and timing become crucial. This setup strongly favours the front runner and prominent racers — the soft pace allows them to control their effort and kick clear when the hold-up horses are still getting organized.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Drombane Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Drombane gets an easy lead and times his effort perfectly from the front
scenarios.body: Paul Townend can dictate every fraction and kick clear when the field is still getting organized behind him. The Mullins runner's class edge shows when he's allowed to use his tactical speed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Fabhcun and Lord Of The Locke track Drombane closely and pounce late
scenarios.body: The Elliott and Byrnes runners can use their handy positions to challenge the leader in the final furlong when he's done his work. Their fresher finishes prove decisive in a tactical finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes even slower and the field compacts further
scenarios.body: Kaiser De Chanay or Keep Em Quite can use their superior finishing kicks from off the pace. The bunched field suits horses with turn of foot who can weave through traffic.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shock Outsider Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the favorites fail to fire and traffic causes chaos
scenarios.body: Lord De Choisel or Deebert can capitalize on a messy finish where class doesn't tell. Fresh legs and a clear run prove more valuable than ratings.

watchPoints.text: Drombane's jumping under pressure - hasn't won for nearly two months and needs to handle Townend's tactical ride
Kaiser De Chanay wearing first-time tongue tie which could sharpen him up significantly from his handy mark
Lord De Choisel with apprentice Paddy Cody taking 7lbs off - unusual booking often signals stable confidence
Keep Em Quite was pulled up last time which raises fitness concerns despite trainer persisting
Fabhcun and Courageous Cleo both from Elliott's yard running different tactics - stable may fancy the prominent runner more

races.paceDynamic: Concert Party is the lone confirmed front runner in this large field and will dictate proceedings from the outset, with Evelyn likely to track in second early on. With 15 hold-up horses behind them, Concert Party can set a sustainable tempo without early pressure, potentially getting an easy lead through the first mile. The pace will be steady rather than strong early, but the sheer volume of hold-up horses means a cavalry charge from the back straight as traffic problems develop. This setup strongly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and avoid the inevitable late traffic — hold-up horses will struggle to get clear runs in time.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Tracking Victory
scenarios.trigger: If Concert Party sets steady fractions and prominent runners avoid trouble
scenarios.body: The early leaders get first run on the field while hold-up horses get shuffled back in traffic. Evelyn and any others who can sit handy benefit from clear sailing while the pack behind struggles for room.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong or Concert Party weakens turning in
scenarios.body: The hold-up brigade gets organized despite the numbers and the best stayers come through late. Superior horses like Bearami Creek and Midnight Eagle use their class to navigate traffic and finish strongest.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Longshot Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If favorites hit trouble and an outsider gets the perfect trip tracking Concert Party
scenarios.body: A mid-range horse sitting in the right position capitalizes on a clean run while higher-rated rivals get compromised. The pace setup allows a tactical ride to triumph over pure ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Concert Party goes too fast early or there are multiple fallers at hurdles
scenarios.body: The race becomes a scramble where anything can happen and surviving horses with stamina prevail. Form goes out the window as only those who avoid trouble and stay on their feet matter.

watchPoints.text: Concert Party must handle the 2m trip as previous wins came over shorter - any signs of weakening turning in could collapse the pace scenario
Traffic problems are inevitable with 15 hold-up horses - watch for which runners get clear runs versus those trapped on the inner
First-time headgear on Finnicky Filly, Evelyn and Cry Before Dawn suggests trainers expect improvement from these three
Dolly Watkins running back after just 2 days indicates strong stable confidence but quick turnaround is unusual
Multiple apprentice and conditional jockeys booked suggests several trainers are not fully confident in their chances

races.paceDynamic: Marlpark will make the running from the outset with his natural front-running style, likely getting an uncontested lead early. Stay In The Game, Tingarran Express, Gino Bella and Keiths Boy will track in prominent positions but none are confirmed pace pressers. The large field of hold-up horses including Palace Boy, Our Uncle Jack, Silent Selector, Blue Train and Market Ready will settle towards the rear, creating a strung-out field as Marlpark dictates terms. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the pace will be genuine enough to set up a finish for closers, and the field will stretch out over 2 miles on soft ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Marlpark sets steady fractions without early pressure from prominent runners
scenarios.body: The lone leader will come back to the field in the straight as the soft ground takes its toll, allowing the army of hold-up horses to close strongly. Palace Boy and Our Uncle Jack have the class and tactical advantage to capitalize on this patient ride setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Stay In The Game or Tingarran Express apply early pressure to Marlpark
scenarios.body: The pace quickens beyond sustainable levels, stretching the field and creating gaps for the prominently-raced horses to exploit before the hold-up brigade can get organized. Tingarran Express has been running well lately and can bridge the gap between pace and closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Marlpark gets completely uncontested fractions and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage on horses that are poorly positioned to respond quickly enough over this shorter trip. Marlpark's recent second at soft Tramore shows he handles these conditions and can sustain a gallop.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners converge on Marlpark before halfway
scenarios.body: The early burn-out creates a messy, stop-start affair that suits nothing in particular but may favor the most talented on ratings. Our Uncle Jack's class could shine through tactical chaos given his recent winning form.

watchPoints.text: Marlpark must be monitored for early pace — if he goes too fast early the race falls apart tactically
Palace Boy returning from 115-day break with amateur jockey could be rusty despite previous winning form
Our Uncle Jack's recent winning form and preference for testing ground makes him the one to beat
Multiple first-time tongue-ties on Crohan Lady and Gino Bella suggest stable concerns about breathing
Stay In The Game represents the Hanlon stable who are running well but this horse has been off since August
